summary: Route Mode slice 6b. The user-facing side of the learning map: a Today panel (progress, exploration share, concepts being read) and a source badge on every recommendation card (route / basics / explore with concept and layer); a learning-map page (route.html) with per-concept status and explicit counts, undoable marks, map editing with a revision check, a literature check and a mode switch; the creation page's prerequisite editing now uses id-keyed checkboxes. Server: marks follow a concept only when its id and name are unchanged, duplicate names are refused, the empty route carries a revision, and the home summary is cheap (off map: no matching; enabled map: cached by a signature). No model call from these pages.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode, on top of e863bb3. The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call and no new outbound data: the literature check (an explicit click) sends only each concept's first search term to OpenAlex, as before.
budget_impact.before: The learning map could be created and drive recommendations but was invisible after creation.
budget_impact.after: Visible, editable, undoable; every card says how it was chosen.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

reviews.reviewer: One separate read-only code-review agent (same model family, not a human); findings fixed afterwards, fixes not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: route-page.js has no automated DOM test; its behaviour was verified by hand in a browser preview and its helpers by node tests.
The independent review was by an agent of the same model family; its findings were fixed and the fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.
Existing projects have no map and can only get one by hand until the owner decides whether AI generation may be used outside the creation session.
The knowledge-base (Cytoscape) page does not show the map, the profile page has no Route Mode block, and there is no UI for growing the map (slice 7).
Not exercised: the Tauri window, dark mode, narrow layouts, keyboard-only use.
The home summary cache is per process and keyed by a signature; a change it does not track (for example a paper edited in place) would not refresh it until a tracked value changes.
